notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hello Guys,

Implemented a few suggestions of a user.

 1. Enemies made a noise now, when you are in the near

2. The weapons can now be picked up automatically when the player go over them 

3. Implemented an aim toggle

4. Deleted the Sequence in the first level

In the future i will add also more Video settings and a few more possiblity to kill enemies.
